rules.text: The phone tester places a real call to the selected number. Reserve real numbers for deliberate tests.
rules.why: A real dial can reach the recipient even when confirmation is delayed.

rules.text: The public API does not provide a simulated phone network or a general live-monitor control endpoint.
rules.instead: Test request construction with fixtures. Use the dashboard to observe an authorised real call.

rules.text: Use the monitor to inspect authorised live calls. Media connection and final call outcome are distinct observations.
Choose a suitable test scenario and check the result before repeating a test.
A monitor connection loss does not prove that the call ended. Recheck live status and inspect the final record.
Use call history with the test source filter for recorded test activity.
If tester_call_unconfirmed is reported, check whether the phone call started before trying again.
